typesense:explore.greeting:
*YYou're in the midst of traversing the rooms and corridors of the Hadal Blacksite, sent on a mission by Urbanshade to retrieve the crystal at the ridge.*

*During your door opening fiesta, you come across an oddly big room compared to the previous ones, with two platforms and a big middle platform, each side platform connected to the middle platform.*

*You walk across a long suspended walkway, making your way to the big middle platform. You step foot on the platform and begin to walk to the front of it.*

*On your way there, you see a massive white angel, and also a document atop a drawer. You pick it up and read the name "Guardian Angel of The Badlands."*

*The Guardian Angel hangs far from the front of the platform, missing it's lower half. It's arms are tightly secured to two large tubes, and two smaller black tubes are embedded in it's arms connecting the two large tubes. The sides of it's torso have 3 black wires pierced in it, and a multitude of wires coming out of the bottom that are connected to large tubes, all sucking out it's Pureblood.*

*Once the angel notices you approaching, it makes a noise similar to a low guttural roar. It looks down at you, you look up at it.*
typesense:explore.name: Banlands Guardian
typesense:explore.title: Encounter with the Guardian Angel of The Banlands | Pressure
